I am currently using Poisson regression to model scores of NBA games, but for now, I am just treating scores in one match independently. In reality, the scores are correlated(Teams are motivated to score more if their opponents score more.)
That's why I want to use a Bivariate Poisson to model the scores, to capture some dependencies between the scores.
